snippet.title: Highway to Heal - Gameplay Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
Highway to Heal is an open-world driving adventure game set in a climate-friendly future city. Hit the streets as Jakub & Mishra, our paramedic duo on duty to rescue locals. Face traffic, storms and more, the clock is ticking! 

If you'd like to support the development of this game, consider supporting our crowdfunding campaign. You'll even be allowed to name a street of the city! https://ulule.com/highwaytoheal

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213710/Highway_to_Heal/

The footage used in this teaser is WORK IN PROGRESS. Graphics, Audio and Gameplay WILL change and improve before the final release.
